note: Maintained manually by GeminiMan. Plans are aspirations, not release promises: finish the current Wellness Companion BP research milestone, take a break, then return to broader development.

postBpSequence.title: Give BP research the attention it needs
postBpSequence.description: Focus on Wellness Companion blood pressure research, signal quality and validation until the current work reaches a dependable milestone.

postBpSequence.title: Take a deserved break
postBpSequence.description: Step back, rest and recharge after the concentrated blood pressure development period. No dates or promises attached.

postBpSequence.title: Return to the wider workshop
postBpSequence.description: Explore more wellness features, WearOS Manager screen mirroring, Journal, Clock Chimes and the next generation of practical tools.

projects.name: Wellness Companion
projects.description: ECG features, experimental V3 blood pressure research, and careful phone-watch testing. BP estimates are not clinically validated.

projects.name: WearOS Manager
projects.description: Wireless ADB, pairing, diagnostics, and the planned watch screen-mirroring experiment.

projects.name: GeminiMan Local ADB
projects.description: Run local ADB workflows without repeatedly reaching for a computer. A phone-capable expansion has been built and is waiting for its public update.

projects.name: WearOS Battery Stats
projects.description: Understand how a watch spends its battery through practical history, usage trends and monitoring tools. More refinements are waiting their turn.

projects.name: Journal app
projects.description: A quieter space for recording thoughts, moments and memories. Development will resume after current priorities and a proper break.

projects.name: Developer Mode Manager
projects.description: Simple controls for switching Android developer settings on and off, with room for a clearer and more convenient experience.

projects.name: Encryption Checker
projects.description: Device encryption and verified-boot information, with its latest planned maintenance update now completed.

projects.name: GeminiMan Text Reader
projects.description: A comfortable way to spend time with text, with readability and interface refinements among the ideas to revisit.

projects.name: Pay Planner
projects.description: A practical planning companion for organizing payments and staying ahead of upcoming commitments, with more features to explore later.

projects.name: Ads Deleter Browser
projects.description: A browsing utility shaped around fewer distractions, awaiting its next compatibility and usability pass.

projects.name: Noise Meter
projects.description: An easy-to-read sound level meter concept to help make sense of everyday noise, with thoughtful presentation and appropriate accuracy limits.

projects.name: Clock Chimes
projects.description: A clock-inspired chime and sound experience that has already been implemented privately. The next step would be refreshing it, testing it and preparing a public release.

projects.name: Clipboard
projects.description: A future clipboard utility for handling copied snippets more conveniently, with privacy and clear control over what gets retained.

projects.name: File Manager
projects.description: A possible file browsing and organization tool built around straightforward navigation, useful operations and a lightweight interface.

items.title: Blood pressure V3 research and validation
items.summary: Investigate a third-generation hybrid model using more varied PPG data, subject-separated evaluation and cuff-reference comparisons. Blood pressure estimates remain experimental and are not clinically validated.

items.title: ECG and measurement experience
items.summary: Improve ECG/BP recording, history, reporting, phone-watch transfer, and closed-beta diagnostics.

items.title: More wellness features after BP
items.summary: Return to additional sensor insights, health trends and other wellness ideas when the BP foundations are dependable. See the illustrated four-phase GitHub plan.

items.title: Compatibility and connection reliability
items.summary: Keep wireless ADB, pairing, discovery, onboarding, and Android/Wear OS compatibility reliable.

items.title: Watch screen mirroring
items.summary: Investigate mirroring a connected watch screen onto the phone, including latency, performance and platform compatibility.

items.title: Phone-capable Local ADB release
items.summary: Prepare the existing phone functionality expansion for testing and publication when higher-priority research permits.

items.title: Battery insights and beta refinements
items.summary: Resume improvements to battery trends, activity analysis, monitoring reliability, and feedback from beta users.

items.title: Prepare the first public release
items.summary: Return to the journal experience, refresh its design, test the foundations and prepare a modest first release.

items.title: Developer workflow improvements
items.summary: Return to compatibility, usability and maintenance updates when scheduling allows.

items.title: Reading experience refinements
items.summary: Revisit accessibility, typography and usability in a later development cycle.

items.title: Planning interface improvements
items.summary: Review the planning workflow and prioritize useful refinements.

items.title: Browser maintenance
items.summary: Return to browser compatibility and reliability after current projects stabilize.

items.title: Explore a noise level utility
items.summary: Investigate a useful sound-level interface and realistic device-specific measurement limits before committing to implementation.

items.title: Refresh and publish the chime experience
items.summary: Review the existing unpublished implementation, revamp its visuals and sounds, then test before any public release.

items.title: Explore useful clipboard workflows
items.summary: Consider snippet organization and convenient reuse, designed with privacy and modern platform restrictions in mind.

items.title: Sketch a lightweight file manager
items.summary: Study simple file browsing and organization needs, then design around modern Android storage protections.
